name: gantt
title: Gantt
description: A project Gantt chart with a grouped task sidebar and a month timeline. Feature bars are coloured by status and can be dragged or resized, with milestone markers and a today line.
use: A product roadmap or project plan needs draggable bars across months with grouped tasks.
avoid: You only need a simple list of dates; this ships a large Gantt with drag and extending scroll.
a11y: Sidebar rows work from the keyboard, but moving and resizing bars needs a pointer; no reduced-motion handling. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide dark chart split into a left list of grouped task rows and a month grid. Short rounded bars in grey, amber and green sit on the rows, with year and month labels across the top and marker tags above them.
behaves: Dragging a bar moves it horizontally along the timeline and its edge handles resize it; hovering an empty column offers an add button. Clicking a sidebar row scrolls the timeline to that feature, and the today line marks the current date.
customise: Give the provider a range and zoom, then pass grouped features and markers; statuses carry their own colours. Row height, column width and sidebar width are provider props.
weight: moderate: Many positioned bars with drag listeners across a scrollable grid, but no per-frame loop.
